lines.text: "Welcome to the Guild Hall. Registering, posting a commission, or just sheltering from the weather?"
"Aren't you a bit small for monster hunting? Come back at twelve and I'll write your name in the book myself."
"Our newest F-rank! The board's that way. Try not to die, the paperwork is dreadful."
"{player}! My favourite adventurer. Don't tell the others."
"Morning. Fresh commissions went up at dawn, first come first served."
"You're dripping on my floor. Contracts are on the board, towels are not."
"Report's ready to file, I see. Let's have it."
"You're hurt. The herbalist is two doors down. Commissions will keep."
"F to S. Everyone starts at F, no matter whose child you are. Finish commissions for points; enough points and the branch master signs your next rank."
"Fail a commission and it costs you points, and sometimes coin. Take what you can finish."
"Quiet week. Which in this trade means something big is about to happen."
"Between us, the Mossfang goblins have been bolder since the rift started glowing. Nobody's paid to deal with them yet."
"Adventurers who've been out west come back talking about a hollow where the trees whisper. Nobody posts contracts there. Nobody needs to."
